title: ONVIF camera controls
savedConnection: Device controls use the saved server connection, not unsaved connection edits. Save connection changes above before connecting. Credentials remain on the server.
readOnly: Read only: the camera did not report usable editing options.
readFailed: The camera service is unavailable, unsupported, or rejected authentication. No device write was retried.
writeFailed: The requested device operation was rejected. Refresh the camera's current values before trying a different change.
unverified: The camera may have applied all or part of the change, or another client changed the settings. The write was not retried. Review refreshed values and explicitly reconcile ownership before continuing.
confirm: I understand this changes the physical camera image for every client. Apply once, verify the result, and pause image automation for 15 minutes.
persist: Explicitly persist these settings on the device across reboots (otherwise request temporary settings).

copy.title: Apply staged image changes to other cameras
copy.help: Choose source changes above first. Read each target independently, select its physical source, review its actual ranges and current values, then authorize that target. This copies only staged image values, never credentials, connections, NVR settings, or automation opt-ins. Every write is temporary and creates a 15-minute manual override.
copy.chooseChanges: Stage at least one source image change before previewing targets.
copy.compatible: All staged fields fit this target's reported options. Review mode dependencies before authorizing.
copy.incompatible: This target did not advertise compatible options for: {{fields}}
copy.targetConsent: I authorize these physical image changes on {{camera}}.
copy.consent: I reviewed every selected target and authorize one device write per selected camera. Failures will not be retried or rolled back automatically.
copy.verified: This target confirmed the requested values.
copy.unverified: This target did not confirm the change. It may have applied partially. Read the camera again and reconcile ownership before another write.
copy.readFailed: Target capabilities could not be read. No target write was made.

standardRange: Standard ONVIF normalized range: {{min}} to {{max}} (camera-reported Level support required)

ptzProfiles.savedConnection: Read PTZ profiles using the saved connection. Save connection changes before reading. Image and encoder profiles are separate from PTZ profiles.
ptzProfiles.empty: The camera did not report a PTZ-capable media profile. Fixed cameras can still support image and encoder controls below.

discovery.title: Discover cameras for onboarding
discovery.help: One three-second ONVIF multicast discovery on the local network. Results are addresses only. Enter a chosen address in the connection form above; no camera is added and no credentials are copied automatically.
discovery.confirm: I authorize one local-network discovery request.

imaging.title: Physical image settings
imaging.description: Controls use camera-reported options and explicitly labeled ONVIF-standard intervals. Unsupported controls remain read only. Image source selection is separate from the PTZ profile. Changes are temporary unless device persistence is explicitly selected.
imaging.noiseReduction: Standard noise-reduction Level is editable only when the camera reports Level support and a readable normalized value. ONVIF defines this level from 0 to 1. Vendor-specific 2D/3D algorithms and undocumented ranges are never assumed.
imaging.chooseSource: This camera reports multiple physical sources. Choose the intended lens before reading or changing its image.

ownership.label: Image ownership
ownership.conflict: Configuration or capability conflict, automation suspended
ownership.connection_changed: Saved camera connection changed, automation suspended
ownership.in_flight: Device write was started but not durably verified, automation suspended
ownership.journal_unavailable: Physical image ownership journal is unavailable
ownership.resume: Accept current image as baseline and resume automation

profiles.transferHelp: Capture reported editable values as JSON, or paste values from another camera. Validate against this target camera before applying. This transfers no connections or credentials. Manual-only gains require their corresponding MANUAL mode. Review every value and explicitly confirm the physical write.
profiles.invalid: The JSON contains unsupported controls, invalid values, or limits not reported by this target camera.
profiles.automationHelp: In advanced environmental settings, map existing NVR profile names to an explicit image-source profile_token and settings map, then opt in with Allow physical camera automation. The same selected environmental plan drives both layers. Physical settings use temporary device writes and guarded baseline restoration. They do not change NVR stream configuration.

encoder.title: Camera video encoder
encoder.description: Edit camera-advertised codecs and parameters, not NVR stream bindings. Shared encoder configurations affect every listed media profile. Unsupported codecs and unreported vendor extensions are not guessed.
encoder.switchHelp: Changing codec can interrupt every shared stream. Choose a codec profile and GOP length when the camera reports target-codec options for them. All retained or changed parameters must fit the target codec's reported limits; missing limits are rejected, not guessed.
encoder.persistenceRequired: Media2 does not provide a temporary-write flag. Explicit device persistence is required for a Media2 encoder change.
encoder.confirm: I understand this changes the physical encoder for all clients and shared profiles, and may interrupt streams. Apply once and verify readback.

catalog.title: Reported media profiles and sources
catalog.description: Read saved-camera Media1 or Media2 profiles independently of PTZ. A reported service or profile is not proof that every operation is supported. Each control below reads and validates its own options before a write.
catalog.empty: The camera reported no media profiles for this service.

audio.title: Camera audio encoder
audio.description: Read physical Media1 or explicitly selected Media2 audio encoder options. A microphone, codec, bitrate, or sample rate is never assumed. Sample rates are displayed in the camera's ONVIF kilohertz units, not replay-transcode settings.
audio.persistenceRequired: Media2 audio does not provide a temporary-write flag. Explicit device persistence is required before sending a Media2 audio encoder change.
audio.unsupported: This profile did not report both an audio source and an audio encoder. Audio control is unavailable for this selection.
audio.confirm: I authorize one physical audio encoder change for all shared profiles and clients. Streams may be interrupted. Apply once and verify readback.

focus.title: Camera lens focus
focus.description: Only camera-reported absolute focus movement with a readable position is exposed here. No continuous motor movement or lens support is assumed. Manual autofocus mode must be selected in physical image settings first. Active or uncertain image automation blocks focus movement.
focus.unsupported: The camera did not advertise absolute focus movement. Fixed-focus cameras do not have a software focus or optical zoom control.
focus.manualRequired: Read only: a readable position and MANUAL autofocus mode are required. Review physical image settings and image ownership before moving the lens.
focus.confirm: I authorize one absolute physical lens move. All clients may see a focus change. A pending or unverified move is never retried automatically.

administration.title: Advanced ONVIF device administration
administration.description: Administrator-only operations from camera-advertised services and real installed WSDL bindings. Discovery lists schema-defined operations, not proof the camera implements each optional operation. No operation runs until you explicitly submit it. Camera credentials and SOAP endpoints stay on the server.
administration.load: Read advertised service and operation catalog
administration.backupWarning: A camera backup may contain passwords, keys and private configuration. It is downloaded directly to your browser, not published in Frigate exports. Store it securely. This ZIP contains a manifest and the camera's original backup bytes; it is not a generic file to upload directly to the camera.
administration.backupConsent: I authorize downloading this camera's sensitive backup to this browser.
administration.backupFailed: The camera backup could not be downloaded. The camera may not support inline backup data, or the connection or catalog changed. No restore or device change was requested.
administration.restoreWarning: Restoring can replace camera settings, credentials and networking, interrupt recordings and disconnect all clients. Use only a compatible backup for this physical camera. File checks cannot guarantee device or firmware compatibility. There is no automatic retry or rollback.
administration.restoreTooLarge: The upload exceeds 33 MiB. Decoded backup files are limited to 32 MiB combined.
administration.restoreConsent: I verified this backup belongs to this camera and authorize one disruptive restore.
administration.catalogReady: Client bindings and forms are available for the reported catalog. Device operation support remains unverified until an explicit request succeeds.
administration.catalogPartial: The catalog contains client-binding, managed-workflow, file-transfer, or schema gaps. These are not evidence that the camera lacks those capabilities. Review each operation's readiness below.
administration.bindingAvailable: Client WSDL binding available: {{count}} schema-defined operations.
administration.bindingUnavailable: The camera advertised this service, but no complete client binding is available. This is a client limitation, not a device-unsupported result.
administration.endpointRejected: The advertised SOAP endpoint is outside the saved camera, contains credentials or query data, or would downgrade a saved HTTPS connection. It is blocked by connection policy, not classified as unsupported hardware.
administration.coverage: Client readiness: {{ready}} generic forms, {{managed}} managed workflows, {{files}} protected file transfers, {{schemas}} unresolved request schemas, {{references}} operations requiring a scoped service reference. These counts are not device-support claims.
administration.unverifiedSupport: This operation exists in the installed WSDL. The camera has not yet confirmed that it implements it.

readiness.ready: A WSDL-backed form is available. Optional opaque vendor extensions are not invented.
readiness.managed_workflow: Use the dedicated image, encoder, focus, PTZ, event, or SD workflow above for the capabilities it exposes. Other fields in this WSDL operation require an ownership-aware or source-scoped client integration and are not executable through this generic form. This is a client-safety limitation, not a device-unsupported result.
readiness.schema_unavailable: The required request includes a recursive, wildcard, or unresolved schema. No request is sent using an invented structure.
readiness.file_transfer_required: This operation requires protected binary upload or download handling. It is not available through the generic JSON form. A redacted response is not a working backup, restore, certificate export, or firmware transfer.
readiness.protected_output: This operation can return sensitive opaque content and requires a protected download workflow. It is not executed through this generic JSON form.
readiness.service_reference_required: The installed WSDL defines this operation on a different service binding. A scoped, server-owned subscription or other service reference is required. The advertised base service URL cannot safely substitute for that reference, and caller-supplied SOAP URLs are not accepted.

administration.disruptive: Device administration can interrupt all camera clients, change networking or access, delete recordings or users, reboot the camera, or reset settings. Every non-read or unclassified operation is treated as a device change. Release physical image ownership before administration. There is no automatic retry or rollback.
administration.confirm: I reviewed these WSDL fields and authorize exactly one operation on this physical camera, including any disruption to other clients.
administration.invalid: The entered fields do not match the WSDL form. Review the required fields and types.
administration.readComplete: The explicit read completed. Sensitive fields, opaque XML, and URI authentication or reference details are not displayed.
administration.unsupportedOperation: The camera explicitly rejected this operation with a standard unsupported-action SOAP fault. This does not mean that the advertised service or other operations are unsupported.
administration.unverified: The camera acknowledged this operation, but its outcome has not been independently verified. Do not repeat the write. Use the corresponding read operation or the camera's management interface to reconcile the result.
administration.bindingAvailable_one: Client WSDL binding available: {{count}} schema-defined operation.
administration.bindingAvailable_other: Client WSDL binding available: {{count}} schema-defined operations.
administration.bindingUnavailable_one: The camera advertised this service, but no complete client binding is available. This is a client limitation, not a device-unsupported result.
administration.bindingUnavailable_other: The camera advertised this service, but no complete client binding is available. This is a client limitation, not a device-unsupported result.

presets.title: Camera PTZ presets
presets.description: Use a separately selected PTZ-capable profile. Creating or replacing a preset saves the camera's current position. Moving the camera can interrupt autotracking; stop autotracking before manual moves.
presets.name: Preset name
presets.confirm: I authorize one physical PTZ preset action or camera movement.

events.title: Camera native events
events.description: Opt-in runtime PullPoint subscription with lease renewal and reconnection. Stops on configuration replacement or service shutdown. Only topic names and receipt times are retained, not arbitrary vendor payloads. These are camera-native events, not Frigate detections.
events.confirm: I authorize starting or stopping this camera's native event subscription.
events.integrationHelp: Status/history only is the default. A separate runtime opt-in can create bounded external ONVIF motion/alarm events in Frigate's existing manual-event and review pipeline. Recording retention follows camera policy. No person, vehicle, object class, detection confidence, or bounding box is inferred. Unsupported vendor topics remain history only.
events.integrationConsent: Opt in this runtime subscription to external ONVIF motion/alarm events and camera recording/review policies.
events.integrationActive: External ONVIF NVR integration is enabled for this subscription.
events.statusOnly: Status/history only; NVR integration is disabled.
events.sourceProfile: Native event physical source media profile
events.signalCounts: External ONVIF signals: {{active}} active, {{starts}} started, {{ends}} ended
events.signalUnavailable: The native-event NVR signal bus is unavailable. Camera status/history can continue, but event delivery is not confirmed.

binding.title: Bind SD recordings to this physical source
binding.help: Required before SD access. Only administrators can discover device-wide recording sources. Select the actual lens/profile and its recording source, then save all three binding fields in the advanced ONVIF connection form above. Viewers cannot override this saved binding.
binding.configured: An explicit SD recording binding is saved. Source/profile attribution is revalidated on search and playback.
binding.required: SD access is blocked until a complete, unambiguous source binding is saved.
binding.unattributed: The camera did not provide stable recording source attribution. SD access remains blocked rather than exposing all device recordings.
binding.copy: Copy only the three source binding fields
binding.copyFailed: The binding could not be copied. Select the displayed values manually.
binding.saveHelp: Enter these exact values in Recording source media profile, Recording physical video source, and Recording source reference above, then Save or Save All. Existing connection drafts are not changed automatically. Never copy these identity fields to another lens.
binding.viewerHelp: SD search and playback use this camera's administrator-saved media/video/recording source binding. Missing or ambiguous attribution is denied.

recordings.title: Camera SD recordings
recordings.description: Search the camera's ONVIF recording index, not Frigate storage. Use a timezone-aware local interval of no more than seven days. Results are bounded to 100 camera recording entries and may represent long recording spans rather than individual clips.
recordings.browserHelp: Authenticated replay of the selected fixed range, transcoded to H.264 with optional AAC-LC audio at 48 kHz. Use the player's controls to unmute recorded audio. Camera URLs, passwords, and vendor query tokens stay on the server. To seek beyond buffered media, close this replay and search a new start time. A camera may include up to five seconds of decoder preroll.

audio.not_requested: Recorded audio is disabled for this browser
audio.available: Recorded audio available: AAC-LC at 48 kHz
audio.not_recorded: This recording reports no recorded audio
audio.not_present: No audio track is present in this replay stream
audio.unavailable: The recording reports audio, but the camera did not provide an audio replay track

recordings.preparing: Preparing a bounded camera replay session
recordings.unsupported: The camera could not provide supported ONVIF clock-range replay, the video was unavailable, or replay capacity is in use. No live-stream fallback was attempted. Close this replay before trying another fixed range.
recordings.ended: Replay ended. Server-side cleanup has been requested.
recordings.cleanupFailed: Replay cleanup could not be confirmed. The temporary session has a bounded expiry.
recordings.verificationFailed: Replay metadata could not be verified. Audio availability may still be unknown.

firmware.title: Camera firmware upgrade
firmware.warning: Use only manufacturer firmware for this exact model and hardware revision. Frigate does not verify vendor signatures or model compatibility. A successful transfer is not proof of installation. Firmware may reboot or disable the camera, interrupt recording, or erase settings. Keep power connected. The listed WSDL methods do not prove the camera supports firmware updates.
firmware.size: Select a non-empty firmware file no larger than 32 MiB.
firmware.typed: Type the exact selected firmware operation name
firmware.confirm: I verified the firmware model and hardware revision, backed up the camera, and authorize one firmware transfer without an automatic retry.
firmware.uploading: Firmware request in progress. Do not disconnect power.
firmware.unverified: Firmware outcome is unknown. The request was not retried. Do not resubmit until you independently check the camera's status and firmware version.
firmware.acknowledged_unverified: The camera acknowledged the transfer, not installation. Wait for its maintenance cycle, then independently check the camera firmware version before another operation.
firmware.unsupported: The camera explicitly reported that this firmware operation is unsupported. No automatic fallback or retry was attempted.
